summary: Creating an authentication method in the platform gateway: Access Management > Authentication Methods > Create authentication, a unique Name of up to 512 characters (renaming doesn't change the generated unique identifier), the Authentication type, Enabled, and Create Objects, which creates the teams and organizations named in the authenticator maps at login.
questions: How do I add an authentication method in AAP 2.6?
Why can't I reuse an authenticator name in AAP?
What does Create Objects do on an AAP authenticator?
